body:
New apps2/crystal -seed/-seed-out flags (headless N-tick run + JSON world-snapshot dump). server/mob/crystal.go: MeadowCrystalSpawns loads a seed, converts goblins/foxes into real Mob entities (kind-differentiated stats, world-coordinate-mapped positions matching MeadowWormSpawns' own ring). Wired into apps2/mud/main.go's world init behind CRYSTAL_SEED_PATH env var, optional/additive. Live-verified: real seed generated (48 goblins/32 foxes @ tick 100), real load producing 80 correctly-positioned/typed mobs, real mud server boot with seed loaded, zero errors. 4 new automated tests, full repo build+test clean. NOT git-committed -- this worktree blocks git against the shared GoblinFoxDragon checkout; code changes are written to their real destination paths and fully verified there, but need a manual git add+commit+push. Files: apps2/crystal/main.go (modified), server/mob/crystal.go (new), server/mob/crystal_test.go (new), apps2/mud/main.go (modified: import log, wire MeadowCrystalSpawns call after MeadowWormSpawns).

⚓ ☃
title: Meadow seeded with crystal-generated NPCs (S189-07)
